entities.name: Tajic
entities.description: Commander and First Guildmage of the Boros Legion; human soldier devoted to Aurelia who leads the Warmind Initiative.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: Ravnican guild of martial discipline and swift justice.

entities.name: Aurelia
entities.description: Warleader of the Boros whom Tajic serves.

entities.name: Warmind Initiative
entities.description: Boros-Izzet collaboration to improve weapons, run by Tajic.

entities.name: Implicit Maze
entities.description: Maze Tajic ran as Boros representative and completed.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Became the new Living Guildpact via the Supreme Verdict.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: Asked Tajic to help remove the Obzedat; relationship with him soured.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Enemy forces Aurelia wanted to unite against.

events.summary: Tajic ran the Implicit Maze for the Boros and was at the Forum of Azor when the Supreme Verdict made Jace the Living Guildpact.
Teysa asked Tajic to help remove the Obzedat; the plot failed and the Orzhov imprisoned him until Aurelia freed him.
events.quote: Tajic was taken prisoner by the Orzhov

events.summary: Tajic opposed Aurelia's plan to unite the guilds against Bolas.
events.quote: Tajic later opposed Aurelia's plan to unite with the other guilds

relations.quote: First Guildmage of the Boros Legion
